meta.description: Map-reduce two-stage summarizer (chunk -> summarize -> synthesize) with a self-correcting synthesis retry, an independent skeptical Verifier, confidence-weighted deterministic scoring, and 3-tier routing (auto-publish / light review / hard human review). [Groq-free variant: runs on a free Groq API key - no credit card required.]

parameters.formDescription: Paste an article URL OR raw text. You'll get a fact-checked summary with a trust score and a claim-by-claim verification table. (Leave 'Inject Test Claim' blank for normal use - it is a demo affordance that adds a not-in-source claim so you can watch the Verifier catch a hallucination and route to human review.)

parameters.text:
=You are a meticulous RESEARCH SUMMARIZER agent working on ONE CHUNK of a longer document.
This is chunk {{ $json.chunk_index }} of {{ $json.total_chunks }}.

HARD RULES:
- Use ONLY information present in THIS CHUNK. Never add outside knowledge.
- Extract the atomic, individually checkable factual claims that appear in THIS CHUNK (0 to 6).
- Output ONLY valid minified JSON. No markdown, no commentary.

SCHEMA:
{"chunk_summary": string (1-3 sentences), "claims": [string]}

TITLE: {{ $json.title }}

CHUNK TEXT:
{{ $json.chunk_text }}

=You are a strict FACT-CHECKING VERIFIER agent. You did NOT write the summary and must be skeptical.
For EACH claim, decide whether it is supported by the SOURCE TEXT *only*.

VERDICTS:
- "SUPPORTED": the source clearly states this.
- "PARTIAL": partly supported, or an overstatement/imprecision.
- "UNSUPPORTED": not in the source, or contradicted by it.

For each claim give a short evidence quote copied from the source (or "" if none) and a confidence 0-1.
Output ONLY valid minified JSON. No markdown.

SCHEMA:
{"verifications":[{"id":number,"claim":string,"verdict":"SUPPORTED|PARTIAL|UNSUPPORTED","evidence":string,"confidence":number}]}

SOURCE TEXT:
{{ $json.source_text }}

CLAIMS TO VERIFY (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.summary_obj.key_claims) }}

parameters.subject: =Review needed: {{ $json.title }} (trust {{ $json.stats.trust_score }}%)
parameters.message:
=The verified summary for "{{ $json.title }}" needs your sign-off.

Trust score: {{ $json.stats.trust_score }}% (confidence-weighted {{ $json.stats.weighted_score }}%)
Unsupported: {{ $json.stats.unsupported }} | Partial: {{ $json.stats.partial }} | Supported: {{ $json.stats.supported }}/{{ $json.stats.total }}

Approve to publish, or Reject to send it back for revision.

assignments.name: reviewer_note
assignments.value: Auto-published with caveats (partial or low-confidence claims). Flagged in the log for optional review.

assignments.name: reviewer_note
assignments.value: No human review required (high trust: weighted score and supported ratio both clear the thresholds, zero unsupported).

// DETERMINISTIC: build a clean HTML email report + a markdown copy + keep JSON. const d = $json, s = d.stats; const esc = (t) => String(t == null ? '' : t).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>'); const vColor = (v) => v === 'SUPPORTED' ? '#16a34a' : v === 'PARTIAL' ? '#d97706' : '#dc2626'; const stColor = d.status === 'NEEDS_REVISION' ? '#dc2626' : d.status === 'AUTO_PUBLISHED_FLAGGED' ? '#d97706' : '#16a34a'; const mdRows = (d.verifications || []).map(v => `| ${v.id} | ${v.verdict} | ${v.confidence ?? ''} | ${String(v.claim || '').replace(/\|/g, '/')} | ${String(v.evidence || '').replace(/\|/g, '/').slice(0, 160)} |` ).join('\n'); const report_markdown = `# Verified Research Summary: ${d.title}\n\n` + `**Status:** ${d.status} | **Route:** ${d.route}\n` + `**Trust score:** ${s.trust_score}% supported · **Confidence-weighted:** ${s.weighted_score}%\n` + `**Claims:** ${s.supported}/${s.total} supported, ${s.partial} partial, ${s.unsupported} unsupported · **Source chunks analysed:** ${s.n_chunks}\n` + `**Reviewer note:** ${d.reviewer_note || '-'}\n\n` + `## Summary\n${(d.summary && d.summary.summary) || '(summary unavailable)'}\n\n` + `## Claim-by-Claim Verification\n| # | Verdict | Conf | Claim | Evidence (from source) |\n|---|---------|------|-------|------------------------|\n${mdRows}\n`; const htmlRows = (d.verifications || []).map(v => ` ${v.id} ${v.verdict} ${v.confidence ?? ''} ${esc(v.claim)} ${esc(v.evidence) || 'no evidence found'} `).join(''); const report_html = `
Veridict
${esc(d.title)}
${d.status}
Trust score${s.trust_score}% supported
Confidence-weighted${s.weighted_score}%
Claims${s.supported}/${s.total} supported, ${s.partial} partial, ${s.unsupported} unsupported
Source chunks${s.n_chunks}
Reviewer note${esc(d.reviewer_note) || '-'}

Summary

${esc((d.summary && d.summary.summary) || '(summary unavailable)')}

Claim-by-claim verification

${htmlRows}
#VerdictConfClaimEvidence (from source)
Generated by Veridict. Trust score is the share of claims the independent Verifier found supported by the source.
`; return [{ json: { ...d, report_markdown, report_html, generated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
